settings.label: Entire party earns AP
settings.description: FFX: award AP to eligible party members without requiring every member to act.

settings.label: Permanent Sensor
settings.description: FFX: show enemy information without equipping a weapon with Sensor.

settings.label: Playable Seymour
settings.description: FFX: add Seymour to the playable party.

settings.label: Maximum speed
settings.description: FFX: speed boost cycles from 1x up to this multiplier.

settings.label: Speed step multiplier
settings.description: FFX: multiply the current speed by this amount when cycling speed boost.

settings.label: Skip dialogue at speed
settings.description: FFX: bypass audio synchronization at or above this speed. Set above the maximum speed to keep dialogue synchronization.

settings.label: Disable custom speed timing
settings.description: FFX: disable UnX timing hooks and return speed to 1x.

settings.description: Choose asset language for all supported games. Text and subtitles follow the Steam game language.

settings.description: Choose asset language for all supported games. Text and subtitles follow the Steam game language.

settings.label: Enable DirectInput remapping
settings.description: Apply the DirectInput button map and UnX background input handling. Native XInput button assignments are unchanged.

settings.label: Controller slot
settings.description: Choose the XInput controller used by UnX shortcuts. Automatic currently selects slot 0.

settings.label: Fast exit
settings.description: Allow the game window to close without its usual confirmation handling.

settings.label: Filter background input
settings.description: Block keyboard and raw input messages while the game is inactive. Requires Fast exit to be enabled.

settings.label: Trap Alt+Tab notifications
settings.description: Prevent the game from receiving selected window activation notifications when changing applications.

settings.label: Controller button icons
settings.description: Choose an installed icon pack under the texture resource folder. Xbox packs change button artwork, not controller support.

settings.label: DirectInput: X / Square
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: A / Cross
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: B / Circle
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: Y / Triangle
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: Left shoulder
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: Right shoulder
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: Left trigger
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: Right trigger
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: Back / Select
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: Start
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: Left stick click
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: DirectInput: Right stick click
settings.description: Map this logical button to a 1-based DirectInput button number. Requires DirectInput remapping; native XInput controls are unaffected.

settings.label: Keyboard: Cycle speed boost
settings.description: FFX: cycle through the configured speed multipliers. Use Ctrl, Alt, and Shift joined with a key by +.

settings.label: Keyboard: Fix stuck loading
settings.description: Recreate the window size to recover from a stuck loading transition. Use Ctrl, Alt, and Shift joined with a key by +.

settings.label: Keyboard: Toggle time stop
settings.description: FFX: pause or resume game progression. Use Ctrl, Alt, and Shift joined with a key by +.

settings.label: Keyboard: Toggle free look
settings.description: FFX: toggle the debug camera control flag. Use Ctrl, Alt, and Shift joined with a key by +.

settings.label: Keyboard: Toggle permanent Sensor
settings.description: FFX: enable or disable permanent Sensor. Use Ctrl, Alt, and Shift joined with a key by +.

settings.label: Keyboard: Toggle full party AP
settings.description: FFX: enable or disable AP for eligible party members. Use Ctrl, Alt, and Shift joined with a key by +.

settings.label: Keyboard: Toggle VSync
settings.description: Switch the presentation interval between VSync off and on. Use Ctrl, Alt, and Shift joined with a key by +.

settings.label: Keyboard: Soft reset
settings.description: FFX: trigger game over in battle or restart the game outside battle. Use Ctrl, Alt, and Shift joined with a key by +.

settings.label: Controller: Cycle speed boost
settings.description: FFX: cycle through the configured speed multipliers. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Controller: Fix stuck loading
settings.description: Recover from a stuck loading transition. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Controller: Send F1
settings.description: Send the game's built-in F1 booster key. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Controller: Send F2
settings.description: Send the game's built-in F2 booster key. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Controller: Send F3
settings.description: Send the game's built-in F3 booster key. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Controller: Send F4
settings.description: Send the game's built-in F4 booster key. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Controller: Send F5
settings.description: Send the game's built-in F5 booster key. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Controller: Escape
settings.description: Send Escape to open or dismiss game menus. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Controller: Toggle fullscreen
settings.description: Send Alt+Enter to switch window mode. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Controller: Soft reset
settings.description: FFX: trigger game over in battle or restart outside battle. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Controller: Steam screenshot
settings.description: Capture a screenshot through Steam. Join button names with +; Xbox and PlayStation names are accepted. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Disable Windows DPI scaling
settings.description: Let UnX request DPI-aware rendering to avoid Windows scaling the game window.

settings.label: Bypass Intel adapter
settings.description: Legacy adapter-selection override. Keep disabled unless an Intel adapter prevents the game from selecting its dedicated GPU.

settings.label: Texture resource folder
settings.description: Folder containing gamepads, injected textures, and other UnX resources. Relative paths are resolved from the game folder.

settings.label: Enable texture replacement
settings.description: Load replacement textures, including controller icon packs.

settings.label: Cache textures
settings.description: Reuse textures managed by the legacy Special K texture cache.

settings.label: Dump textures
settings.description: Write discovered game textures to the resource folder for mod development.

settings.label: Borderless window
settings.description: Remove borders from the game window.

settings.label: Fill screen
settings.description: Scale the borderless window to fill the monitor. This is a maximized window, not exclusive fullscreen.

settings.label: Center window
settings.description: Center the game window on its monitor.

settings.label: Render in background
settings.description: Continue rendering while another application has focus.

settings.label: Mute in background
settings.description: Mute game audio while another application has focus.

settings.label: Remember window position
settings.description: Keep the window position after dragging it.

settings.label: Correct resized mouse coordinates
settings.description: Adjust mouse coordinates after resizing the game window.

settings.label: Prevent screensaver
settings.description: Prevent the Windows screensaver while the game is running.

settings.label: Window resolution override
settings.description: Client size in WIDTHxHEIGHT form. Use 0x0 to let the game choose.

settings.label: X window offset
settings.description: Window position offset in pixels, or a percentage ending in %.

settings.label: Y window offset
settings.description: Window position offset in pixels, or a percentage ending in %.

settings.label: Always on top
settings.description: Control whether the game window stays above other windows.

settings.label: Confine cursor
settings.description: Keep the mouse pointer inside the game window.

settings.label: Release cursor
settings.description: Prevent the game from restricting the mouse pointer. Leave disabled when confining the cursor.

settings.label: Force exclusive fullscreen
settings.description: Request exclusive fullscreen through DXGI. Leave disabled when forcing windowed mode.

settings.label: Force windowed mode
settings.description: Request windowed presentation through DXGI. Leave disabled when forcing exclusive fullscreen.

settings.label: Frame rate limit
settings.description: Special K frame limiter. Use 0 to disable this extra limiter; the game retains its own timing.

settings.label: VSync
settings.description: Choose the DXGI presentation interval. Higher intervals wait additional refresh cycles.

settings.label: Back buffer count
settings.description: Override the swapchain back buffer count. Flip-discard presentation requires at least two buffers.

settings.label: Frames rendered ahead
settings.description: Limit queued frames. Use -1 to leave the game setting unchanged, or 0 for the DXGI default.

settings.label: Fullscreen refresh rate
settings.description: Refresh rate in Hz. Use -1 to leave it to the game.

settings.label: Wait for vertical blank
settings.description: Make the legacy frame limiter wait for vertical blank.

settings.label: Keep render thread awake
settings.description: Prevent sleeping on the render thread. This changes CPU scheduling.

settings.label: Keep window thread awake
settings.description: Prevent sleeping on the window thread. This changes CPU scheduling.

settings.label: Use flip discard
settings.description: Use the Windows flip-discard swapchain presentation path when available.

settings.label: Safe fullscreen handling
settings.description: Enable the legacy engine's fullscreen transition compatibility handling.

settings.label: Allow DWM tearing
settings.description: Allow tearing through the legacy desktop composition path.

settings.label: 64-bit depth-stencil surfaces
settings.description: Replace depth-stencil allocations with the legacy enhanced-depth format.

settings.label: Rehook presentation
settings.description: Restore the presentation hook if another overlay changes it.

settings.label: Display scaling
settings.description: Choose the DXGI scaling preference.

settings.label: Swapchain wait
settings.description: Legacy swapchain wait time in milliseconds. Use 0 to disable.

settings.label: Minimum reported resolution
settings.description: Filter reported display modes with WIDTHxHEIGHT. Use 0x0 for no constraint.

settings.label: Maximum reported resolution
settings.description: Filter reported display modes with WIDTHxHEIGHT. Use 0x0 for no constraint.

settings.label: D3D11 exception mode
settings.description: Choose the legacy engine's D3D11 exception handling preference.

settings.label: Maximum cached textures
settings.description: Upper target for the number of cached textures.

settings.label: Minimum cached textures
settings.description: Minimum number of textures to retain while evicting cache entries.

settings.label: Maximum texture cache (MiB)
settings.description: Upper memory target for the legacy texture cache.

settings.label: Minimum texture cache (MiB)
settings.description: Minimum memory target while trimming the texture cache.

settings.label: Maximum eviction batch
settings.description: Maximum textures removed during a cache eviction batch.

settings.label: Minimum eviction batch
settings.description: Minimum textures removed during a cache eviction batch.

settings.label: Ignore textures without mipmaps
settings.description: Skip non-mipmapped textures in the legacy cache.

settings.label: Process staging textures
settings.description: Allow caching, dumping, and replacement of staging textures.

settings.label: Precise texture hashes
settings.description: Use the legacy engine's precise texture hashing path. Existing replacement packs may depend on the original hashing mode.

settings.label: Keep injected texture format
settings.description: Preserve the expected texture format during replacement.

settings.label: Generate texture mipmaps
settings.description: Create missing mip levels when loading replacement textures.

settings.label: Dump textures on first load
settings.description: Dump textures when the legacy engine first loads them.

settings.label: Enable XInput integration
settings.description: Keep enabled for UnX controller shortcuts and Special K controller navigation.

settings.label: Rehook XInput
settings.description: Reinstall XInput hooks if another input layer changes them.

settings.label: Disable PS4 HID input
settings.description: Disable the native PS4 HID path to avoid duplicate input when another layer provides XInput.

settings.label: Controller feedback in mod menus
settings.description: Enable vibration feedback while navigating Special K menus.

settings.label: Disable controller vibration
settings.description: Disable rumble across the input APIs managed by the legacy Special K engine.

settings.label: Enable Special K DirectInput hooks
settings.description: Keep enabled for UnX DirectInput remapping and keyboard state handling.

settings.label: Enable Special K HID hooks
settings.description: Enable HID input integration in the legacy engine.

settings.label: Mod menu controller
settings.description: XInput controller slot that navigates the Special K menu.

settings.label: XInput placeholder mask
settings.description: Bit mask for virtual connected slots: 1, 2, 4, and 8 represent controller slots 0 through 3. Use 0 for none.

settings.label: XInput slot order
settings.description: Four comma-separated controller slot numbers, such as 0,1,2,3. Applies before UnX controller polling.

settings.label: Automatically manage cursor
settings.description: Let Special K hide the mouse cursor after inactivity.

settings.label: Keyboard shows cursor
settings.description: Show the cursor when keyboard input is detected.

settings.label: Cursor inactivity timeout
settings.description: Seconds before hiding the cursor. Use 0 to keep the game cursor hidden while automatic management is enabled.

settings.label: Enable crash logs
settings.description: Use Special K's custom crash handler and crash log collection.

settings.label: Log detail
settings.description: Diagnostic log verbosity, from general messages to detailed debugging.

settings.label: Trace loaded libraries
settings.description: Record DLL loading and enable legacy dynamic API detection.

settings.label: Initialization delay
settings.description: Delay before legacy Special K initialization, in milliseconds.
